summary: Frontend-only retest of Vishal Jadon 3D scroll portfolio against the targeted correction spec. All 9 requested checkpoints pass. Opening loads directly on the giant 3D red YouTube play button (no intro clip). WORK section reveals 4 channel cards and rotates through them in the exact required sequence Acharya Prashant -> Josh Talks Hindi -> Zee Switch -> UNKNOWN FACTS HINDI, with COLOR avatars (not grayscale). Credential card is premium red+white, becomes readable then exits. Gallery photos visible. Contact section has correct email + instagram with NO youtube link. Suggestion (non-blocking): gallery next/prev buttons work when gallery is in view; when triggered while gallery-layer is not visible (during regression flows) the photo index does not advance. Not a user-facing bug but worth guarding for accessibility/keyboard use.
